parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-28 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 853.6 | 0.80 | 0.80
2 | 1156.2 | 1.92 | 2.72
3 | 234.7 | 7.57 | 10.29
4 | 2817.0 | 39.25 | 49.54
5 | 234.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-28
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: > 49.54 m (deep target; secondary shallow zone at 2.72–10.29 m)
Recommendation: Drill through the resistive bedrock formation to intercept the lower fractured aquifer zone starting at 49.54 m, continuing to a target depth of at least 60–65 m. Ensure adequate casing is set through the overburden and upper weathered zone.
